name: Garlic Chives

companions.note: Deters aphids and soft-bodied pests from brassicas
Same pest deterrence; compatible fall timing
Garlic chives repel aphids that target brassicas
Compatible timing and spacing; both benefit from allium pest deterrence

pnw_notes: Flat, solid leaves with mild garlic flavor — classic in Korean and Chinese cooking. White flowers in late summer are edible and beautiful for pollinators. Spreads readily by self-seeding; deadhead flowers to keep contained. Divide clumps every 2–3 years. NOT safe for Jazzy or cats — allium family.

frost_hardiness.notes: Perennial — goes fully dormant in winter and returns reliably in spring without any intervention.

planting_windows.notes: Fall transplant — roots establish well in cool soil; harvest begins next spring
Snip leaves 2 in above soil; harvest white flowers in August before they fade
